targetTexts.1: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
targetTexts.2: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
targetTexts.3: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
targetTexts.4: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
targetTexts.5: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
targetTexts.6: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
targetTexts.7: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
targetTexts.8: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
targetTexts.9: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
targetTexts.10: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
targetTexts.11: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
targetTexts.12: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
targetTexts.13: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
targetTexts.14: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
targetTexts.15: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
targetTexts.16: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
targetTexts.17: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
targetTexts.18: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
targetTexts.19: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
targetTexts.20: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
targetTexts.21: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
targetTexts.22: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
targetTexts.23: So He said He would destroy them—had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
targetTexts.24: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
targetTexts.25: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
targetTexts.26: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
targetTexts.27: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
targetTexts.28: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
targetTexts.29: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
targetTexts.30: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
targetTexts.31: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
targetTexts.32: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
targetTexts.33: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
targetTexts.34: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
targetTexts.35: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
targetTexts.36: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
targetTexts.37: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
targetTexts.38: They shed innocent blood—the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
targetTexts.39: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
targetTexts.40: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
targetTexts.41: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
targetTexts.42: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
targetTexts.43: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
targetTexts.44: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
targetTexts.45: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
targetTexts.46: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
targetTexts.47: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
targetTexts.48: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
